notes: «ح» separates two heads; «عن سهيل، عن أبيه، عن أبي هريرة» is written once after the last «ح», so it is the shared tail of both branches (rule 3)
«نحوه» is a remark of likeness and «زاد وهب في حديثه» an addition by Wahb: wording, left out
«أبيه» is a bare relation; the Prophet's words are the saying, Abu Hurayra is the last link
